# The Welcome Link

> A small studio in Puerto Escondido, Oaxaca, Mexico, that builds direct booking websites, custom digital welcome guides and short listing videos (Villa Reels) for vacation rental hosts, villas, rental collections and property managers. Everything is done for you, bilingual in English and Spanish, and mobile first. Contact is by WhatsApp: +52 954 206 1152.

Founded by Trevor, a host who lives in Puerto Escondido. The work is local and human: real recommendations from people who live here, designed around each property's character, carrying the host's own brand rather than ours. Serves Puerto Escondido (Zicatela, La Punta, Brisas de Zicatela, Punta Pájaros, La Barra, Rinconada, Carrizalillo) and the wider Oaxaca coast.

## Services

- [Direct booking websites](https://thewelcomelink.com/websites/): bilingual sites for a single villa or a collection of homes, a page per home, booking by WhatsApp so hosts keep more of each stay than through platform fees. Landing page from $350 USD ($6,650 MXN), villa site $700 USD ($13,300 MXN), collection site from $1,400 USD ($26,600 MXN). Optional monthly care plan for updates and hosting.
- [Welcome guides](https://thewelcomelink.com/): a custom mobile web page guests open before and during their stay, with arrival directions, WiFi, house notes, checkout, curated local food and experiences, and one tap contact with the host. Built in about 48 hours. Included with every website, and the first guide for a new host is free.
- [Villa Reels](https://thewelcomelink.com/reels/): short vertical videos made from the listing photos a host already has, for Instagram, TikTok and listing pages. No new shoot, nothing invented. $200 USD ($3,800 MXN) per home, $150 USD each for three or more.

Prices are in USD, pesos accepted at about 19 MXN per dollar. Every project is quoted to fit.

## Work

- [Tierra en Armonía case study](https://thewelcomelink.com/work/tierra-en-armonia/): eight homes on one piece of land in La Barra, Puerto Escondido, brought online as one bilingual website with a guest guide for each home. Live site: https://www.tierraenarmonia.com.mx/
- [Casa Yani case study](https://thewelcomelink.com/work/casa-yani/): a custom welcome guide for a remote mountain retreat in the Sierra Sur of Oaxaca.

## Example guides

- [Casa Las Nubes](https://thewelcomelink.com/casa-las-nubes/): the founder's own home in Puerto Escondido.
- [Casa Yani](https://thewelcomelink.com/casa-yani/): mountain retreat, San Sebastián Río Hondo.

## En español

The Welcome Link es un estudio en Puerto Escondido, Oaxaca, que hace sitios web de reserva directa, guías de bienvenida digitales para huéspedes y videos cortos (Villa Reels) para anfitriones de Airbnb y renta vacacional, villas y administradores de propiedades. Todo hecho por nosotros, bilingüe en español e inglés. Contacto por WhatsApp: +52 954 206 1152.
